zh: 除总经办外，所有部门人员都可以考勤打卡：自动定位 + 直接打开相机拍现场照片（带水印）；总经办可看全员打卡汇总
定位更稳：App 直接用手机 GPS；GPS 关着时一键打开开关 / 权限；实在定不到时用网络大致位置并标记
App 第一次打开时一次性申请定位、相机、麦克风权限，以后不再问；“我的 → 手机权限”可随时查看和打开
打印：App 里调用系统打印，自动搜索同一 WiFi 的网络打印机；“我的 → 打印机”可搜索打印机、打印测试页
财务确认收款：已全额收款的订单直接“核对无误，放行”，多收时提醒检查重复登记
en: Everyone except the GM office can check in: GPS + in-app camera photo with watermark; the GM office sees everyone's records
More reliable location: native GPS in the app, one-tap GPS / permission settings, approximate network location as a flagged fallback
The app asks for location, camera and microphone once on first start; Me → Phone permissions shows and fixes them
Printing: system print in the app finds WiFi network printers automatically; Me → Printers searches printers and prints a test page
Finance: fully paid orders can be released directly; over-payments are flagged
